claims.claim: For finite common-kernel full-support quiescent categorical histories, source-path score S_s and bracket V_s yield first response E[Y S_s] and Hessian E[Y(S_s S_u-delta_su V_s)]. Hit response is causal, with exact contact E[q_s(1-q_s)] and future history-mediated E[q_t S_s]. Measurable prehistory anchors preserve finite odd/even contrast expectations.
claims.limit: Finite specified ideal randomized law, four quiescent draws per wave, source-independent downstream at fixed history; independent exact rational examples, direct pulse only wave8; not physical equilibrium FDT or universal variance reduction.

claims.claim: For equal mixture of two finite common-support prefix path laws, exact RN contrast uses bounded weights w_F=2 sigmoid(log(P_F/P_C)), w_C=2-w_F. Equal per-arm independent samples yield stratified unbiased finite contrast for source-independent observables. Actual R66 comparisons retain overlap and sampling discrepancies.
claims.limit: Standard importance-weight identity applied and verified here, no novelty or independent estimator superiority claim. R66 schedules separate from R74, no reverse dynamics or equilibrium assumption.
